bullets.text: Mobile Boost Creates 49,000 Businesses - **VodafoneThree** research shows improved connectivity could add £6.6bn to the UK economy.
Agentic AI Optimizes 5G at Sea - **BubbleRAN** and **Telenor** launch AI-driven network optimization for maritime connectivity.
Boldyn Upgrades Silverstone's 5G Network - New high-capacity 5G network enhances connectivity for fans and teams at **Silverstone**.
Telefónica Launches Edge Computing Services - **Telefónica** activates B2B edge services in Spain, enhancing local data processing.
AI Reshapes 6G Network Planning - AI's role in future **6G** networks is crucial for adapting to evolving service demands.
Ericsson's AI Network Optimization Live - **Ericsson** launches AI-powered services to enhance network autonomy and efficiency.
